name: personal-os
install: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && (command -v bun >/dev/null || (curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash)) && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib openssl >/dev/null && bun install
start: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bash scripts/ensure-postgres.sh && bash scripts/cloud-materialize-env.sh && cd packages/db && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5432/personal-os}" bun x drizzle-kit push --force
